text:
sophia: FYI BluePine Labs (acct BP-314) INV-2026-523 for $27,340 is overdue. Sent dunning emails on 2034998000 and 2035000800. They replied asking for a breakdown and a short-term payment plan citing a delayed enterprise PO. @mark can you take a look?

mark: Can you paste the billed lines? want to confirm overage vs reserved and any credits.

sophia: Pasting export snippet (redacted):

``
INV-2026-523
- Reserved cluster (monthly): $14,000
- Token overages (peak events): $13,700
- Support: $400
- Credits applied: -$760 (promotional)
Total: $27,340
```

sophia: They claim the overage stemmed from a scheduled load test that mistakenly targeted prod for ~6 hours on 2026-05-02 and that their procurement delay is blocking the PO. They provided a ticket ID but no signed remediation attestation yet.

allen: Our traffic logs do show a concentrated spike matching their time range with several identical request hashes -> likely retries. I'll pull a short trace to confirm.

mark: Given they're mid-market but at-risk, propose a 3-month installment (3 equal payments) with a 1% administrative fee. Require: signed remediation attestation, PO/ACH before first installment, and a 72-hour acceptance window. If our audit finds platform fault we'll issue a pro-rated credit and refund admin fee. Thoughts @carmen?

carmen: I prefer 2 installments to shorten exposure. 3 is ok if we add a conditional clause: if we detect repeated misconfigured retries (>8%) next billing cycle we can accelerate the plan. Also request sales to confirm whether churn risk warrants leniency.

sales-rep: From AE POV, BluePine is a strategic trial conversion. Avoid hard escalation if we can keep them. I'd back the 3-month plan to ease their cashflow, but require the remediation attestation and monitoring access.

mark: OK compromise: 3-month installments, 1% fee, include conditional acceleration clause and require a remediation attestation and read-only trace link for the incident window. Draft below.

sophia: Draft to customer (please review):

"Hi BluePine team,

We acknowledge your note regarding INV-2026-523. To help you while procurement completes, we can offer a 3-month installment plan. Terms: total including 1% administrative fee = $27,613.40, payable as three equal monthly payments of $9,204.47. Conditions: (1) signed remediation attestation within 72 hours; (2) ACH or PO before the first installment; (3) read-only trace access for the incident window to facilitate our audit. If our audit determines platform fault we will issue a pro-rated credit and refund the administrative fee. If we detect >8% repeated retry behavior in the following billing cycle we reserve the right to accelerate the remaining balance and/or pause service. Acceptance of the payment plan does not waive our rights to collections in cases of misrepresentation. Please reply within 72 hours to accept.

Thanks,
Accounts Receivable"

carmen: Language good. Add one line: "This offer is contingent on receiving the PO or ACH before the first payment date."

mark: Add that and I'm ready to approve. Also note: any credit requires RevEng signoff.

allen: I'll post trace snippets here by EOD so RevEng can start the audit. If we find any platform-related cause we'll reverse.

collections-bot: reminder email sent to BluePine Labs at 2035001300 (email + webhook).

sophia: I'll send the offer now and cc Sales + Legal. If no response in 72 hours, escalate to formal collections and open a ledger hold.

sales-rep: I'll follow up on the AE side and keep relationship warm.

mark: Approved. sophia, once sent add this to the "managed payment plans" tracker and set follow-ups for each installment.

sophia: Sent at 2035001368, cc'ing sales/legal. Will update thread when they accept or decline. :thumbsup:
